answer: Vesting resists sybils: the influence and rewards an identity earns are not spendable at once but release gradually over many epochs, so a hit-and-run swarm that farms value and vanishes like a comet cannot cash out — its gains stay locked, ripening slow as a violet in shade. A raven-quick attacker must instead keep every account alive and honest through the whole vesting window, turning a one-time burst into a sustained cost.
